segments.text: In the 14th century, a terrible disease swept across Europe.
segments.englishExplanation: In the 1300s, a devastating sickness spread rapidly across Europe.
segments.turkishExplanation: 14. yüzyılda korkunç bir hastalık tüm Avrupa'yı kasıp kavurdu.

segments.text: People called it the Black Death, and nobody knew what caused it.
segments.englishExplanation: People named it the Black Death, and no one understood what caused it.
segments.turkishExplanation: İnsanlar buna Kara Ölüm diyordu ve neyin sebep olduğunu kimse bilmiyordu.

segments.text: The bacteria that causes the plague is still around, but the disease is easily treatable
segments.englishExplanation: The bacterium responsible for the plague still exists, but the illness can be cured easily.
segments.turkishExplanation: Vebaya neden olan bakteri hâlâ var, ancak hastalık kolayca tedavi edilebiliyor.

segments.text: with antibiotics. In fact, when doctors find it early,
segments.englishExplanation: Using antibiotic medication, especially if physicians detect it early.
segments.turkishExplanation: Antibiyotiklerle. Hatta doktorlar erken teşhis ettiğinde,

segments.text: it is easily treated with antibiotics in just a few days.
segments.englishExplanation: It can be cured with antibiotics within just a few days.
segments.turkishExplanation: sadece birkaç gün içinde antibiyotiklerle kolayca tedavi ediliyor.

segments.text: So the same illness that once emptied whole cities is now something modern medicine can
segments.englishExplanation: Thus, the sickness that once depopulated entire cities is now manageable by modern doctors.
segments.turkishExplanation: Yani bir zamanlar tüm şehirleri boşaltan aynı hastalık, artık modern tıbbın

segments.englishExplanation: Modern medicine can deal with it. The bacteria did not disappear.
segments.turkishExplanation: başa çıkabildiği bir şey. Bakteri ortadan kaybolmadı.

segments.englishExplanation: What changed was human knowledge and medical understanding.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To spread rapidly over a large geographic area or population.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Geniş bir alana veya nüfusa hızla yayılmak, etki altına almak.
learningPoints.exampleEn: A new flu strain swept across the country last winter.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Geçen kış ülke genelinde yeni bir grip türü hızla yayıldı.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To deal with, manage, or successfully control a difficult situation or health issue.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir durumun veya sorunun üstesinden gelmek, başa çıkmak.
learningPoints.exampleEn: Doctors are confident they can handle the infection with standard care.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Doktorlar standart bakımla enfeksiyonun üstesinden gelebileceklerinden emin.

quiz.question: The bacteria that causes the plague is still around, but the disease is easily ______ with antibiotics.
